 Agriculture Minister Gita Chaudhary Assures Inclusive Participation in COP-31
 RSS
 November 06, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Minister for Agriculture, Forest and Environment Gita Chaudhary has stated that the government is aware of ensuring equal and meaningful participation of youth, Gen Z, women, indigenous peoples, and persons with disabilities in the 31st Conference of the Parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP-31).
 In a discussion with civil society representatives regarding the preparation and Nepal's participation in COP-31, Minister Chaudhary said that the voices of all classes, communities, and groups should be included in the international forum on climate change.
 During the discussion, civil society representatives suggested that youth, Gen Z, women, indigenous peoples, and persons with disabilities should be equally involved in COP-31.
 The participants in the discussion stated that meaningful representation of all communities is necessary to effectively raise the issues and voices of communities directly affected by the impacts of climate change in the international forum.
 Addressing the suggestions of the representatives, Minister Chaudhary mentioned that the participation and representation of all are important on the issue of climate change. She stated that she is serious about making Nepal's participation in COP-31 inclusive and prioritizing the issues of affected communities.
 During the discussion, Nepal's priorities in COP-31, climate justice, climate finance, mountain conservation, and the effective presentation of issues of communities affected by climate change at the international level were also discussed.
